name: io.github.christianclaudio/espn
description: Model Context Protocol server for live & historical sports stats and odds via ESPN.

environmentVariables.name: ESPN_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: List and run only tools annotated readOnlyHint=true; refuse every other call

environmentVariables.name: ESPN_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Profile: full, games, teams, news, readonly, gameday, betting, scouting, season

environmentVariables.name: ESPN_MCP_ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH
environmentVariables.description: Replace tools/list with search_tools + call_tool (profile full only)

environmentVariables.name: ESPN_MCP_TOOL_SEARCH_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Tool Search backend: regex or bm25

environmentVariables.name: ESPN_MCP_ENABLE_CODE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Experimental Code Mode: search, get_schema, execute (profile full only; not with Tool Search; needs fastmcp[code-mode], otherwise skipped with a warning)
